_doc: DECIMATION (player/decimation.js). THE BROKEN: when your army routs (FieldBattle: battle.sim.routed 'player'; the one-shot combat's moraleBreak 'player') or your commissioned host is beaten (Generalship.settleBattle), the men who ran wait on your word for windowDays (player.decimation.broken). DECIMATE: they draw lots and every tenth man is beaten to death by his comrades. Your own army: a tenth of the companies (units) that fought, at least one when there were minUnits or more; their kit goes back into your stores (the comrades strip the dead). A host: a tenth of its men, lost to the realm's army. STEEL: for steel.days the army that saw it breaks less: the morale-break chance x steel.breakMult (PlayerMilitary._checkMoraleBreak, FieldBattle._routCheck read Decimation.breakMult); a host's morale for battle + steel.hostMorale. HATRED: hate.gain (0..100), fading hate.decayPerDay a day; while above hate.desertAt men slip away: each week a company deserts with chance hate.desertPerWeek x hate/100 (its kit gone with it, sold on the road); a host loses hate.hostDesert x hate/100 of its men a week; your companions' approval and a host's lieutenants' loyalty drop at the deed (companionApproval, lieutenantLoyalty). The name: Atrocities 'decimate' (karma, the butcher's name, regard, decimation_heard), the gossip 'decimation', Traits cruelty/dread, the House chronicle. AI: when a realm's lines break (world.routFeed from KingdomAI.simulateBattle), its lord decimates them (ai.chance, x ai.cruel for cruel/ruthless/tyrant lords): kingdom.military loses ai.share x ai.tenth of its men; kingdom.decimation { until, breakMult, hate } (KingdomAI._checkMoraleBreak reads breakMult; its stability falls ai.stability; while the hate lasts its army bleeds ai.desert of its men a week).

broken: Your men broke and ran before {foe}. The captains wait to hear what you will do with the companies that fled.
done: The companies that broke draw lots. Every tenth man is beaten to death with clubs by the men beside him; the lot falls on {dead}. No one will run again; no one will forget it either.
Lots are drawn in silence, and fall on {dead}: every tenth man beaten to death by their own comrades while the army watches. The rest will stand next time. They will also remember who gave the order.
spared: You let it go. The men who ran will fight again, or run again.
desert: {unit} slipped away from the camp in the night. The men have not forgiven the lots.
aiDone: 🎲 {ruler} of {realm} has the companies that broke decimated: every tenth man beaten to death by his comrades.
